recommendation_summary: Set up a hosted dead-man's-switch monitor such as Healthchecks.io: a cron wrapper on `edna` pings it at start, success and failure, and it alerts the user by push notification when the job fails or the expected success ping never arrives.
note: The reply recommends one external heartbeat alert, defers central logging, advises against self-hosting on the Synology, and contains none of the four labelled record lines.
